summary.tldr: Lets provinces collect federal personal and corporation income taxes for Canada, and requires talks with Quebec about doing so.
what_it_does: Allows the Minister of Finance, with Governor in Council approval, to sign agreements with a province for that province to collect federal personal and corporation income taxes and send the money to Canada.
Allows the minister, with the same approval, to amend the terms of any tax collection agreement already made.
Requires each agreement to include measures to lessen job impacts on affected workers.
Requires the minister to negotiate changes to income tax treaties, tax agreements, and tax information exchange agreements so the province can get the tax information it needs directly.
Requires the minister to begin talks with Quebec within 90 days and try to reach the agreement within one year.
who_it_affects: People and businesses that pay federal income tax
summary.background: The bill amends an existing federal law that lets Canada make fiscal payments to provinces and enter tax collection agreements with provinces.
